archetypes.name: step5-timing-correctness
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 timing must stay after gates without reviving removed checks wiring.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review only the Step 5 timing changes and related tests. Confirm the wrapper was removed without changing non-fix-applied timing. Confirm fix-applied timing records after gates and still records on gate exceptions. Confirm no post-apply relevant-checks or lint-fix hook was restored. Cite concrete file paths and test names in every finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
